description: Type the missing-budget answer on get/patch/delete. Cloud Billing Budgets returns HTTP 403 PERMISSION_DENIED 'The caller does not have permission' (not 404) for a budget id that does not exist, so a missing budget surfaced as the generic Forbidden.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The budget does not exist (or is outside the caller's billing scope). The Budget API answers HTTP 403 'The caller does not have permission' for a missing budget id instead of 404.

message.includes: The caller does not have permission
